exposure: mode of delivery (elective CS, emergency CS, vaginal delivery)
cohort: Women who gave birth at a tertiary care hospital over a 2-year period
finding: Blood transfusion incidence was 2.67% among all deliveries, with variations based on mode of delivery (1.58% for elective CS, 3.84% for emergency CS, and 2.82% for vaginal delivery).
mod_finding: Mode of delivery influenced blood transfusion rates.
